questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They tell you about hazards ahead on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road is one-way and you cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a winding road with three or more curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a roundabout is coming. Slow down and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead has limited height. Do not enter if your vehicle is taller than the height listed on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Watch for traffic crossing from other directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show sharp curves ahead. The arrow points in the direction of the curve. Multiple chevron signs may appear along the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings alerts you to an upcoming intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The underside of low vehicles may get caught or dragged on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic can only move in the direction the arrow is pointing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On roads with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering the roadway. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let them in safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for yellow lights, red lights, and cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means "Yield." Slow down and check for traffic. Give the right-of-way to pedestrians and oncoming vehicles. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will curve sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns that traffic will merge from the right. Be prepared to allow merging traffic to enter safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means something is not allowed. This sign means U-turns are not permitted in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that the road ahead has many curves and you should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a sharp right turn coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes of traffic are about to become one. You need to merge carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is entering from the right lane and merging into your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride beside the road. Drive carefully in this area because you may encounter bicycles.

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane will end soon and traffic must move to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, but you may not always need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop at a stop sign. Only proceed when it is safe to do so.
